svg.title: Direct Sampling (DS) (Strebelle)
svg.text: Training image: Strebelle · n = 48 · th = 0.12 · f = 0.4 · simulated with G2S pyDev
Visit the next node of the random path
Take its data event: the n = 48 closest simulated nodes
Scan the training image at random positions, compute the distance
Stop at the first distance ≤ th = 0.12 (scan at most f = 40%)
Paste the value of that position into the simulation
Candidate 13: distance not defined (outside the TI) > th

Done: 2 500 nodes simulated, each one from the training image
No simulated node yet: the data event is empty
The grid is filled one node at a time, following a random path
… and so on for every node, faster
… until the whole grid is simulated
